sources.finding: MIT software license; the license explicitly distinguishes third-party data ownership. No additional football dataset introduced.
Older fixture versions exist. Sample commits describe post-GW updates; no timestamped ingestion manifests or complete deadline schedule reconstruction were established.
Sample versions include GW38, GW29 and midseason updates. Git commit time alone does not verify fixture collection time or intervening changes at a deadline.

Each requested season has 38 capture directories. Their file types are bootstrap-static.json.gz, deadlines.json and manifest.json; no fixtures endpoint payloads are present. Three GW15 manifests were inspected.
Original announced December schedule includes Everton-Liverpool on 7 December at 12:30 GMT. An article publication date does not establish a complete immutable schedule at every subsequent deadline.
Official postponement notice keeps the GW15 deadline at 11:00 GMT. The page gives a date, not a precise publication timestamp.

Official rearrangement notice announces 12 February 2025 at 19:30 GMT. The pinned final fixture 144 is assigned GW24, illustrating why its final assignment cannot stand in for a December deadline snapshot.

decision: Use lagged completed scores for team history; keep final opponent/venue/GW assignment/rest-to-kickoff in a separate research-only table. No schedules are promoted into predictive inputs.
